answer: Past the ivory, every newcomer faces the same question — what does this identity actually cost? Joining costs what the network is worth at that moment: a calm epoch is cheap, a crowded one is dear. The wander makes mass registration self-defeating, because the attacker is the congestion — every clone it adds raises the price of the next one. Run through the zephyr and the numbers never favour the farm: one honest agent, one cost; a thousand fakes, a thousand costs.
